pre_condition: work_dir is a directory containing pipeline output files from the preceding stages of the pipeline
post_condition: Returns True if and only if all of the following exist at their expected paths under work_dir: (1) phases.json, (2) spec_prompts/domain_context/engine_overview.txt, and (3) for every phase number P declared in the phases.json file, a file spec_prompts/domain_context/phase_P_types.txt
